---
goal: "Migrate auth from JWT to session tokens"
type: brownfield
max_iterations: 15
constraints:
  - "Zero downtime during migration"
  - "No changes to mobile client API contract"
  - "Must complete within one sprint"
  - "Must support rollback at any point"
---

# Task: verify_session_latency
risk: 0.95

Benchmark the session store. If p99 latency exceeds 50ms,
the migration is not viable. Try to make it slow — hit it with
concurrent requests, large payloads, connection pool exhaustion.

# Task: verify_data_integrity
risk: 0.8

Attempt to create inconsistencies between JWT claims and
session data. Race conditions, expired-but-cached tokens,
partial writes during migration.

# Task: test_pool_pressure
risk: 0.5
depends_on: [verify_session_latency]

Max out the connection pool. If the session store buckles
under load, the migration is DOA.

# Task: validate_rollback
risk: 0.3
depends_on: [verify_session_latency, verify_data_integrity, test_pool_pressure]

Simulate a failed migration and attempt rollback.
Every user must be able to authenticate using their existing
JWT tokens after rollback completes.
